title: 第3章 斩夜螳螂 夜家主系天赋死之瞳第4章 乱斗为了血菩提
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: 注视夜玄头顶一白一紫两道光晕，场中当场鸦雀无声。
就连一众黑袍人，也不禁陷入失神，呼吸急促。
“这是…双天赋御兽师！
有人低声惊呼。
双天赋御兽师，一种数量极其稀少的存在。
身具两种御兽师天赋。
双天赋御兽师一旦得到成长，前途可谓辉煌一片。
“可惜，那叫夜玄的小子，第一天赋是个丁级。”
“丁级又如何，人家第二天赋是乙级级别。”
“哼，话虽如此。”
“但你们貌似忘记一件事，受双天赋影响，双天赋御兽师境界提升缓慢，需砸大量资源，那个丁级天赋，已然成为负担。”
（观前提示，主角有炼妖壶，无视这一限制，炼化出来的灵力，也能自身使用，加速提升御兽师境界，御兽师境界提升可增加寿命，体质，凝聚新的兽契，新的兽契可契约新的妖宠。
黑袍御兽师们窃窃私语，有赞叹，也有惋惜。
我是双天赋？夜玄回过神，心里颇有些意外。
意外中，又夹杂着淡抹惊喜。
“不错，屈指可数的双天赋御兽师。”
猪首面具男难掩赞赏，紧接着，话音一转道：
“但这里是鼻岛，你还得练。”
“只有活下去的天才，才配称之为天才。”
“在场的，大部分人想要杀你。”
猪首面具男说的没错。
此刻，近百道目光汇聚在夜玄身上。
个个手持棍棒，目如饥渴野兽，蠢蠢欲动。
若不是顾及猪首面具男，怕是早就冲过来乱棍砸死夜玄。
道理谁都懂，先联手杀最有潜力的御兽师。
夜玄面无表情，然内心，已然警惕大作！
活下去！
然后向那群暗中害自己来此的幕后黑手复仇！
只有活下去，才能复仇！
“哈哈。”
“先把各自心思收起，在这里，我就是规则。”
“出了黑屋，接下来，你们还需野外合作，才能生存下去。”

;;
Looking at the two haloes of light, one white and one purple, above Ye Xuan's head, the whole place was silent.
Even the men in black robes couldn't help but fell into a daze, breathing rapidly.
"This is... a dual-talented beastmaster!
! "
Someone exclaimed in a low voice.
A dual-talented beastmaster is an extremely rare existence.
He possesses two kinds of beastmaster talents.
Once a dual-talented beast master develops, his future will be brilliant.
"It's a pity that the boy named Ye Xuan's first talent is D level."
"So what if it's level D? My second talent is level B."
"Hmph, that's the case."
"But you seem to have forgotten one thing. Due to the influence of dual talents, the realm of dual-talented beast masters is slow to improve and requires a lot of resources. That D-level talent has become a burden."
(Reminder before viewing, the protagonist has a demon refining pot. Regardless of this restriction, the refined spiritual power can also be used by himself to accelerate the advancement of the realm of the beast master. Improving the realm of the beast master can increase the life span, physical fitness, and condense new beast contracts. The new beast contracts can be used to contract new demon pets.
“…”
The black-robed beast masters whispered among themselves, some with admiration and some with regret.
Am I dual-talented? Ye Xuan came back to his senses, feeling quite surprised.
The accident was mixed with a touch of surprise.
"Yes, one of the few dual-talented beast masters."
The man in the pig-head mask couldn't hide his admiration, and then his voice changed:
"But this is Bi Island, you still have to practice."
"Only geniuses who survive can be called geniuses."
"Most of the people here want to kill you."
The man in the pig-head mask was right.
At this moment, nearly a hundred eyes were focused on Ye Xuan.
All of them were holding sticks and their eyes were like hungry beasts, ready to move.
If he hadn't taken care of the man in the pig-head mask, he would have rushed over and hit Ye Xuan to death with sticks.
Everyone knows the reason, first join forces to kill the most potential beastmaster.
Ye Xuan's face was expressionless, but inside, he was already on alert!
Live!
Then take revenge on the group of masterminds who secretly brought you here!
Only by surviving can you take revenge!
"Haha."
"Stop your thoughts first. Here, I am the rule."
"After leaving the dark room, you still need to cooperate in the wild to survive."
